summary.en: React canvas component with mount-scoped simulation ownership.
summary.zh: 按挂载生命周期拥有模拟的 React 画布组件。

description.en: Render a React canvas and own a particles simulation plus requestAnimationFrame loop.
description.zh: 渲染 React canvas，管理 particles 模拟与 requestAnimationFrame 循环。

description.en: All ParticlesConfig fields plus className, style, and onReady; see the complete props entry.
description.zh: 所有 ParticlesConfig 字段，加上 className、style 和 onReady；详见完整 props 条目。

description.en: A canvas element whose initialization runs after mounting.
description.zh: 一个 canvas 元素，挂载后异步初始化模拟。

constraints.en: Requires React >=18 (optional peer dependency) and browser WebGPU. Component creates its simulation once per mount. Config and onReady changes are ignored by its empty-dependency effect; use a new React key to rebuild.
constraints.zh: 需要 React >=18（可选 peer dependency）和浏览器 WebGPU。每次挂载只创建一次模拟。空依赖 effect 忽略后续 config 和 onReady 变化；使用新的 React key 重建。

constraints.en: The component calls attach(), then onReady(), then ticks on every animation frame. Unmount cancels the scheduled frame and destroys its simulation. Do not run a second tick loop or retain the handle after unmount.
constraints.zh: 组件调用 attach()，随后 onReady()，然后在每个动画帧 tick。卸载时取消已调度帧并销毁模拟。不要另开 tick 循环，也不要在卸载后继续使用句柄。

constraints.en: No onError prop, error UI, pause prop, resize observer, or visibility throttling is provided. Async initialization failures are not caught internally; use the lower-level API when explicit failure control is required.
constraints.zh: 不提供 onError、错误界面、pause、resize observer 或可见性节流。内部不捕获异步初始化错误；需要精确失败控制时使用底层 API。

constraints.en: Canvas style defaults to width:100%, height:100%, display:block, background:#05070c; supplied style overrides these. Give its container a usable height.
constraints.zh: canvas 样式默认为 width:100%、height:100%、display:block、background:#05070c；传入 style 可覆盖。容器应有可用高度。

caption.en: Use key to rebuild when configuration identity changes.
caption.zh: 配置身份变化时使用 key 重建。

exports.name: ParticleCanvasProps
exports.signature: interface ParticleCanvasProps extends ParticlesConfig { className?: string; style?: CSSProperties; onReady?: (sim: ParticlesSim) => void; }

description.en: Complete component props, inheriting the same implementation defaults and constraints as particles().
description.zh: 完整组件 props，继承与 particles() 相同的实现默认值和限制。

description.en: Integer particle count in 1..1_000_000. n2 mode rejects counts above 32_000 (its error text recommends at most 20_000). Device memory limits may be lower.
description.zh: 粒子数量，整数范围 1..1_000_000。n2 模式拒绝超过 32_000 的数量（其错误文案建议不超过 20_000）。设备内存限制可能更低。

description.en: One of cells/snakes/orbitals/viruses, seeded random, or a readonly 16-number tuple. Four species use matrix[mySpecies*4+otherSpecies]; custom arrays are not length/range-validated here.
description.zh: 可选 cells/snakes/orbitals/viruses、带种子的 random 或只读 16 数值元组。四个物种按 matrix[mySpecies*4+otherSpecies] 取值；此处不校验自定义数组长度/范围。

description.en: Neighbor algorithm: all-pairs, workgroup-tiled all-pairs, or spatial grid. The declaration comment saying tiled is the default is stale; implementation defaults to grid.
description.zh: 邻域算法：全量两两计算、workgroup 分块两两计算或空间网格。声明中默认 tiled 的注释已过时；实现默认 grid。

description.en: Canvas coloring by four species or speed magnitude. Used when the renderer is attached.
description.zh: 画布按四种物种或速度大小着色，attach 渲染器时生效。

description.en: How updated positions remain in the square world: wrap or clamp. Interaction distances/neighborhood searches do not wrap across opposite edges.
description.zh: 更新后位置如何保持在方形世界内：环绕或钳位。交互距离/邻域搜索不会跨相对边界环绕。

description.en: Converted to String(seed), then hashed; initializes positions/species and the random force matrix deterministically.
description.zh: 转换为 String(seed) 后散列，确定性地初始化位置、物种和 random 力矩阵。

description.en: Maximum interaction radius in world units. Use a finite positive number. Also affects grid resolution.
description.zh: 世界单位下的最大交互半径，应使用有限正数，也影响网格分辨率。

description.en: Piecewise force-curve breakpoint at normalized distance d/rMax. Meaningful values are between 0 and 1; not validated by this API.
description.zh: 归一化距离 d/rMax 下的分段力曲线分界点。合理值在 0 与 1 之间；API 不验证。

description.en: Acceleration scale: summed interactions are multiplied by forceFactor*rMax before integration.
description.zh: 加速度缩放；交互总和在积分前乘以 forceFactor*rMax。

description.en: Damping time parameter used as exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife). Despite the name, implementation does not include ln(2), so this is an exponential decay time constant rather than a mathematical half-life. Use a positive finite value.
description.zh: 阻尼时间参数，实际公式为 exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife)。虽然名称含 HalfLife，实现没有 ln(2)，数学上是指数衰减时间常数，不是真正半衰期。应使用有限正数。

description.en: Base simulation time step per tick, multiplied by the tick argument. The animation callback elapsed time is not measured automatically.
description.zh: 每次 tick 的基础模拟时间步，乘以 tick 参数；不会自动测量动画回调经过的时间。

description.en: Normalized point-quad half-size used by the attached renderer, approximately in clip coordinates after world scaling. It is not a literal pixel size; shader generation rounds the scaled value to four decimals.
description.zh: attach 渲染器使用的归一化点四边形半尺寸，经世界缩放后近似为裁剪空间坐标尺寸。它不是直接像素值；shader 生成时会把缩放后的值保留四位小数。

description.en: Grid-only candidate budget: ceil(maxNeighbors/9) candidates per each of up to 9 neighboring cells (self may count). Use a finite positive number.
description.zh: 仅 grid 使用的候选预算：最多 9 个相邻格子，每格检查 ceil(maxNeighbors/9) 个候选（自身也可能计入）。应使用有限正数。

description.en: CSS class forwarded to the canvas.
description.zh: 传给 canvas 的 CSS 类名。

description.en: React inline style merged after built-in defaults. This is the React CSSProperties type, not an arbitrary GPU parameter map.
description.zh: 合并在默认样式之后的 React 内联样式。类型是 React CSSProperties，不是任意 GPU 参数映射。

description.en: Initial callback after simulation creation and canvas attachment, before the RAF loop starts. Use setForces/setParams for imperative changes; the component owns destruction.
description.zh: 模拟创建并绑定画布之后、RAF 循环之前调用的初始回调。可用 setForces/setParams 做命令式更新；销毁由组件负责。

description.en: Borrowed simulation handle. Valid only while the component remains mounted.
description.zh: 借用的模拟句柄，仅在组件仍挂载期间有效。

description.en: Standard React CSS style property type; its full browser/React property catalog is outside wgpu-kit.
description.zh: 标准 React CSS 样式属性类型，完整浏览器/React 样式目录不属于 wgpu-kit。

description.en: Use a changed key to remount/recreate the simulation. key is handled by React and is not passed as a normal config field.
description.zh: 改变 key 可重新挂载/重建模拟。key 由 React 处理，不作为普通配置字段传入。

constraints.en: All particle fields retain their documented semantics, including actual mode default grid and the maxNeighbors=Infinity limitation. React adds no extra validation.
constraints.zh: 所有粒子字段保留原有语义，包括 mode 实际默认 grid 和 maxNeighbors=Infinity 的限制。React 层不增加额外验证。
